negation_cue_pattern: ^\s*(?:except|apart from|other than|aside from)\b|n't\b|\b(?:i|i'd|i'll|i would|rather|try to|prefer to|like to)\s+(?:really\s+|just\s+|always\s+)?avoid(?:ing)?\b|\b(?:dont|doesnt|didnt|wont|wouldnt|cant|couldnt|shouldnt|isnt|arent|wasnt|werent|havent|hasnt|hadnt|aint|nah|nope|not|no|never|nor|neither|none|nothing|hate|hated|dislike|cannot|rather not|anything but|can't stand|cant stand)\b
non_preference_pattern: \b(?:don't|dont|do not|wouldn't|wouldnt|would not) mind\b|\bnot sure\b|\b(?:don't|dont|do not) know\b|\bidk\b|\bno preference\b|\b(?:doesn't|doesnt|does not|don't|dont) matter\b|\bno idea\b|\bnot bothered\b
target: negative clause (extractor activity text if explicit) tokenised with the frozen BM25 tokenizer, minus target_filler_words
stemming: suffix strip leaving at least 4 letters (no final e/es); match on equal stems, a >=5-letter stem prefix, or a >=4-letter stem prefix differing by one letter
calibration: reports/ranking/dislike_d2/calibration/calibration.json (calibration probes only; highest threshold within 0.1 of the best avoided-in-top-10 with MRR >= base)

strength_tiers.mild_pattern: \bnot (?:as|that|so|too) (?:much|keen|into|big)\b|\bnot really\b|\bnot (?:a|much of a|the biggest) fan\b|\brather not\b|\b(?:don't|dont|do not) (?:really|particularly|exactly|especially)\b|\b(?:don't|dont|do not) care (?:much|that much|as much)\b|\bnot (?:particularly|especially|exactly|super|very)\b|\bless (?:interested|keen)\b|\bnot my (?:favou?rite|thing)\b|\bnot (?:big|huge) on\b|\bnot as much\b
strength_tiers.strong_pattern: \bhated?\b|\bcan'?t stand\b|\bcannot stand\b|\bnever\b|\bnot for me\b|\bisn'?t for me\b|\bisnt for me\b|\baren'?t for me\b|\b(?:don't|dont|do not|wouldn't|wouldnt|would not) (?:want|like|enjoy)\b|\bdislike\b|\banything but\b|\beverything but\b|\bjust not\b|^\s*(?:except|apart from|other than|aside from)\b|\babsolutely not\b|\bdefinitely not\b|\bno way\b|\bnot at all\b|\brefuse\b|\bavoid(?:ing)?\b
strength_tiers.order: mild first, then strong, else mild
